# NavActiveIgnore.jar

Unmodified file from the
[MQB Coding MIB2 Toolbox](https://github.com/jilleb/mib2-toolbox)
(`Modifications/Lsd/NavActiveIgnore.jar`), MIT licensed (see `LICENSE` beside
this file). The patch was contributed to the toolbox by andrewleech.

sha256 `a4803f7fd008152aca19d4e00b8b45789ac18dccf4cf405d129ce02297982ffe`

It stops the head unit hiding the cluster map while a phone is navigating. The
cluster map needs it. The installer adds it only on firmware where it has been
seen working, and only if it is not already loaded.
